VERDICT: FAIL

[HIGH] `scripts/dispatch/reap-orphans.js:209-214` - POSIX newline row forgery is still not fixed. The parser still splits raw `ps ... args` output on `\n`, then accepts any injected line that matches the fixed `lstart` shape. An argv containing a newline plus `4242 1 Fri Jun 19 10:00:00 2026 /x/dispatch-agent.js` can still forge a candidate row for PID `4242`. Revalidation does not save this because the same forged row appears again and `startMs` matches.  
Fix: do not parse newline-delimited `args` output. Use an enumeration source that cannot be row-forged, or read `/proc/<pid>/stat` + `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` per PID on POSIX. If `ps` remains, use output that escapes args safely or rejects any process row set when embedded-newline ambiguity is detected.

[HIGH] `scripts/dispatch/reap-orphans.js:315` - wrapper signature matching still false-positives foreign processes carrying a path-like argument. The regex accepts any `/dispatch-agent.js` or `\dispatch-claude.js` token anywhere in the command line, not specifically a wrapper script being invoked. A foreign process such as `python worker.py --file /tmp/dispatch-agent.js` can still classify as WarpOS if old/orphaned/unlocked.  
Fix: tokenize command lines and require a known runtime/executable invocation shape, for example `node [node-options] <ROOT>/scripts/dispatch-agent.js`, or compare resolved script paths against the project dispatch script paths.

[MEDIUM] `scripts/dispatch/reap-orphans.js:317-319` - telemetry marker matching is also broader than claimed. `knownExe` can match `node`, `codex`, etc. anywhere as a token in the command line, not necessarily argv[0] or the process executable. A foreign command with `WARPOS_RUN_ID=x` and a stray `node` token can match.  
Fix: require the executable token to be the actual executable position, or inspect a structured executable field rather than free-form `args`.

Resolved from prior review:

CRIT-1 resolved: `classify()` skips non-finite `ageMs` as `age-unknown` at lines `279-280`.

CRIT-2 resolved: `classify()` and `run()` reject non-finite or below-floor `minAgeMs` at lines `257-259` and `418-419`.

CRIT-3 partially improved but not complete because forged POSIX rows can spoof `startMs`; the real-process PID reuse path is much better covered by `revalidateOrphans()` at lines `379-405`.

HIGH-4 resolved: `liveLockPids()` returns `{ ok:false }` on error and `classify()` skips all candidates when `locksOk:false` at lines `99-118` and `273-276`.

HIGH-5 not resolved completely due the false-positive signature paths above.

HIGH-6 not resolved due newline row forgery above. The `pid<=1` and `terminate()` guards fix the process-group kill part, but not forged arbitrary PID rows.

MEDIUM-7 resolved: `terminate()` refuses unsafe PIDs at lines `355-357`.

MEDIUM-8 resolved: `selfTree()` adds descendants via fixed-point sweep at lines `141-151`.
